Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the heads up. High-level guidelines below and Ive attached our guest badging policy for reference.

- Badges: Temporary visitor badges will be issued at the main lobby. For exec-level visitors we can pre-print badges if we receive the roster 48 hours prior.
- Escorting: Non-cleared visitors require an escort when outside the meeting room. Execs with NERC/critical infrastructure access restrictions will need a sponsor escort for any secure zones.
- IDs: We require a government photo ID (passport or drivers license) at check-in. Full DOB is not required for the badge but helpful for pre-clear.
- Background checks: Not required for a two-day workshop; however, contractors/vendors may need a limited check — not applicable to your team.
- Parking: There are 8 visitor spots in Lot B. Please email license plates to security-desk@acme-energy.com by Tue 3/19 17:00 to hold them. Overflow parking is on 5th St.
- Laptops: Devices are allowed but must remain with the visitor. No overnight hardware in secure server rooms.

DocuSign: We need a signed visitor waiver for each external attendee in case of site tours. Ive sent a DocuSign link to the primary contact (Gabe) — he can route it.

Attached: acme-badging-policy.pdf

Let me know when youve uploaded the roster and well queue the pre-print.
